basic_details.job_title: TCIL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 27 Cloud Solution Architect, Data Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Kuwait Projects Office of Telecommunications Consultants India Limited (TCIL), a Govt. of India undertaking under the Department of Telecommunications, Ministry of Communications, invites applications for 17 IT designations (27 job codes, IT-01 to IT-27) on a purely contract basis for the TCIL Kuwait Project, an oil and gas sector project in Kuwait. The posts are for manpower supply on a secondment basis, and the employment contract will be with M/s Ahmed Yousuf Behbehani General Trading & Contracting Co. (AYB). The essential qualification is a Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent degree,

CV with particulars, marital status, availability, qualifications and work experience

important_instructions: No recruitment agent is involved in this selection process, so no payment may be made. TCIL/AYB is in no way responsible if any such payment is made to anybody. After selection and completion of the required visa formalities at Kuwait and India, candidates should be ready to travel as per TCIL Kuwait project requirements at an early date without much delay. Selected candidates must obtain a Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) from the Passport Department of India. Selected candidates must obtain medical clearance from an authorized GAMCA medical center in India. After PCC and GAMCA clearance, selected candidates must get visa stamping on their passport; they may contact the Kuwait Embassy in India directly or through their agent. Qualification certificates should be attested by the Ministry of External Affairs and the Kuwait Embassy in India. TCIL/AYB reserves the right to cancel the recruitment of any candidate at any stage. Any dispute arising in connection with the recruitment process is subject to the jurisdiction of Kuwait.

content_sections.heading: About TCIL
content_sections.text: TCIL is a Govt. of India undertaking established in 1978 under the administrative control of the Department of Telecommunications (DOT), Ministry of Communications, with its Head Office in New Delhi. It executes engineering and consultancy projects. This notice is issued by its Kuwait Projects Office at Bldg-342, Street-145, Block-1, Mahboula, Kuwait, signed by the Deputy General Manager (HR), TCIL, Kuwait. The notice says TCIL's association with Kuwait dates back to the 1980s, when it set up its project office and worked as a prime telecom contractor for the Ministry of Communications. The employment is for the Kuwait project, under the sponsorship of AYB, TCIL's local sponsor in Kuwait.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 27 job codes for 17 designations in Annexure-1 but does not print the number of vacancies for any of them. Some designations appear under more than one job code with different experience requirements. The table gives the experience for each code as printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites qualified and experienced professionals (IT). The required qualification depends on the job code, as below. The experience for each code is in the vacancy table above. Applicants must hold a passport with minimum validity of twelve (12) months from the date of submission. A Kuwait Civil ID copy is to be sent if available. The notice prints no desirable qualification and no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are on a purely contract basis for the TCIL Kuwait Project. The employment contract of a selected candidate will be with AYB, which also issues the work visa and contract; the work visa is arranged and provided by TCIL Kuwait. Salary details of all posts will be communicated later once selected by the client. The notice does not mention the length of the contract.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TCIL Kuwait Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 31 December 2026. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] by that date.

faq.question: Q2. How many designations are advertised?
faq.answer: The notice lists 17 designations across 27 job codes, IT-01 to IT-27. It does not print the number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: It depends on the job code. IT-01 to IT-17 need a Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent degree (more than 3 years of course); IT-18 to IT-26 need a University Degree (B.Com. / B.Sc. Computer Application or equivalent); IT-27 needs a Diploma or University Degree in the listed disciplines or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required?
faq.answer: The minimum relevant experience ranges from 4 years (IT-17 Technical Analyst) to 20 years (IT-18 and IT-19). Each job code's requirement is in the vacancy table.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your CV, certificates, passport copy and Kuwait Civil ID copy (if available) to [email protected]. Mention the Job Code and designation in the subject, for example "IT-05 – Senior Technical Consultant".

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates face an online interview via VC App by the selection committee of the client. The committee's decision is final and binding on TCIL/AYB and candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice states that salary details of all posts will be communicated later once selected by the client.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the positions are on a purely contract basis for the TCIL Kuwait Project. The employment contract of a selected candidate is with M/s Ahmed Yousuf Behbehani General Trading & Contracting Co. (AYB).

faq.question: Q9. Should I pay anyone for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No recruitment agent is involved, so no payment may be made. TCIL/AYB is not responsible if any such payment is made to anybody.

faq.question: Q10. Who arranges the visa for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The work visa is arranged and provided by TCIL Kuwait, while the visa and employment contract are issued by AYB, TCIL's local sponsor in Kuwait. Selected candidates must first obtain a PCC and GAMCA medical clearance in India.
